column1: # Units the budget run synthesises (fpga/budget/README.md). Tab-separated columns:
#   unit      name in budgets.tsv: a plan §8.2 row, or a variant of one
#   cfgs      comma-separated configurations (st, smt2, st_w3, smt2_w3)
#   top       top module; a line is skipped while the module does not exist in its sources
#   files     sources beyond rtl/rtl.f, comma-separated, relative to the repo root (- for none)
# When the core track merges a unit into rtl/core, add its line here (its budget is already
# in budgets.tsv) and drop any spike stand-in for it.
# Core units (core track). Module boundaries against the budget rows: fe (tg_fetch) holds the
# ITLB and lsu (tg_lsu) the DTLB, the walker and the D$, so the mmu row's share is inside them;
# the rob row (ROB, traps, CSRs, PMP) is rob + csr; the rf and int rows are exec (tg_exec: the
# register files, bypass, ALUs, MUL, DIV, branch unit).
